items.title: Charles River Laboratories Recent $470 Million Deal an 'Attractive Strategic Addition,' Analyst Says
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories International Inc. (NYSE:CRL) on Monday agreed to acquire the bioanalysis and drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics (DMPK) operations of Frontage Holdings Corporation in Exton, Pennsylvania, for approximately $470 million in cash. The transaction also includes up to $75 million in performance-based earnout payments, positioning Charles River to capture expanding biopharmaceutical demand. items.summary: Charles River Laboratories International (CRL) moved after reporting its strongest organic revenue growth in three years, a Q3 2026 earnings beat, and higher full-year guidance that pointed to firmer demand and wider margins. Despite the earnings beat, Charles River Laboratories International shares fell 7.27% on the day to $326.29 and are down 12.75% over the past week.
